articles.title: Musk’s X hit by wave of unsolicited password reset emails
articles.snippet: Multiple crypto industry figures and CoinDesk staff received unexpected password reset emails on Tuesday, though there is no evidence yet that X itself has been breached.

articles.title: Ethena pushes stablecoins into everyday banking with high-yield savings, cards and payments
articles.snippet: Ethena Pay offers a 6% dollar savings rate and 5% card cashback, using Avalanche for settlement.

articles.title: Kalshi lays down first lifetime ban for ex-member of Congress George Santos
articles.snippet: The prediction market platform banned Santos for manipulation as part of the industry's ongoing efforts to show it's dealing with bad behavior.

articles.title: NYSE owner ICE taps tZERO for tokenized securities push, takes stake in firm
articles.snippet: The deal adds transfer-agent and settlement infrastructure to ICE's plans for an NYSE-affiliated market for tokenized stocks, tZERO said.

articles.title: BofA, Citi, Goldman Sachs among 21 institutions planning stablecoin launch
articles.snippet: The planned venture will initially focus on a US dollar stablecoin before expanding to other G7 currencies, with a euro-denominated offering next.
